messages:
morgan: Heads-up: publish job blocked. typegen bumped the SDK from 3.4.1 -> 3.5.0 due to generator-only ordering change.
ci-bot: publish-job-7611 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Diff: 3.4.1 -> 3.5.0. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/7611
elaine: I repro'd locally. sample-app auth/retry test flaked, we retriggered a build that used the freshly-built SDK during the publish pipeline. That produced a different field ordering in generated types.
josh: that ordering flip is treated as a minor by the semver guard because typegen preserves input order. Typegen needs a normalization pass before diffing.
pat: quick mitigation: we should not use the just-built SDK artifact for integration tests in the publish gate. Pin to the last released tag to avoid circular regen.
morgan: agree. two tracks: (A) patch pipeline to pin sample-app test artifact, (B) have typegen apply deterministic property/enum sort before diff.
elaine: opening PR to add stable-sort and opt-in normalized diff output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/470. quick unit tests included.
ci-bot: artifacts preserved at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/7611.
pat: short-term: add release label "publish/regen-doc-only" to allow maintainers to override semver guard if diff is ordering-only and approved by release lead. i'll update the playbook.
josh: will submit the pipeline MR today to pin the integration step to latest tag. ETA EOD.
morgan: please also add a one-line note in the release guide and log any overrides in releases channel. target to merge both PRs before tomorrow's release. :thumbsup:
